examName: Assistant Professor (Forensic Science) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-A (Collegiate Branch) Higher and Technical Education - Syllabus
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

papers.paperTitle: Assistant Professor (Forensic Science) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-A (Collegiate Branch) Higher and Technical Education - Syllabus

units.unitTitle: Unit I: Fundamentals of Forensic Science and Criminal Investigations
topics: Definition, History, Development - Scope, Ethics in Forensic Science
Nature, Types of Physical Evidence - Search Methods, Collection, Preservation, Packing, and Forwarding of Evidence for Analysis - Chain of Custody
Types of Crime Scenes - Preservation and Documentation of Crime Scenes.
Criminal Investigations - Various types of Cases: Unnatural Deaths, Assaults, Sexual Offenses, Poisoning, Vehicular Accidents

Types, Powers, and Jurisdiction of Courts - Admissibility of Evidence, Definition of Experts -Relevant Provisions in Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023, Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023, and Bhartiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) 2023 - Court Procedures, Expert Testimony
Forensic Labs at Central and State Levels, NFSU, BPRD, NCRB, NCB
Right to Equality (Articles 14-18) - Right to Freedom (Articles 19-22)
Victim and Culprit Profiling, Role in Investigation, Lie Detection (Polygraphy), Narco-Analysis, Brain Mapping
Management Practices, NABL accreditation
Polarizing, Comparison, Stereoscopic, Fluorescent, Electron Microscopes
U V, Visible, IR, Raman, Atomic Absorption, Emission, ATR-FTIR
Principles, Application in Trace Evidence
XRD, XRF Applications, SEM-EDX
Basic Principles, Applications in Forensic Chemistry
TLC, GLC, HPLC, HPTLC
GC-MS, GC-HS, LC-MS, IR-MS, ICP-MS
Types, Immunoelectrophoresis
Principle, Techniques, Forensic Applications

units.unitTitle: Unit III: Biological Evidence and DNA Profiling
topics: Detection, Species Origin, Blood Group Systems, Blood Group Determination Techniques
Detection of Seminal and Other Body Fluids, Enzymes, Serum Proteins
Paternity and Maternity Testing
Structure, DNA as a Genetic Marker, DNA Extraction, Profiling Techniques, DNA Phenotyping, RNA Profiling
Wildlife Protection Act (1972), Evidence Collection, Identification

units.unitTitle: Unit IV: Toxicology and Analysis of Poisons
topics: Ethanol and Methanol Detection, Breath Analysis
Detection of Chemicals used in Crimes
Pesticides, OP Compounds, Sedatives, Stimulants, Food poisons
Opium and opiates, Cannabis & Drugs of abuse their toxicity
Plant (Datura, Castor, Argemone) & Animal poisons-Snakes
As, Pb, Th, Zn, Hg their Identification detection and Toxicology
Extraction, Isolation, Viscera Analysis

units.unitTitle: Unit V: Firearms, Tool Marks and Ballistics
topics: Types, Composition, Forensic Examination, Velocity, Range and Trajectory, GSR analysis
Examination of Country-Made Firearms
Internal, External, Terminal and Wound Ballistics.
Types, Erased Mark, Restoration

units.unitTitle: Unit VI: Fire, Arson, Explosives and Forensic Photography
topics: Petroleum and Incendiary Materials
Types, Bomb Analysis, IEDs
Protocols & procedures
Documentation Techniques in Crime Investigation

units.unitTitle: Unit VII: Trace Evidence, Digital Forensics, Cyberforensics
topics: Types- Human, animal, Forensic Examination
Applications in Investigation
Composition, Forensic Relevance
Forensic Analysis Techniques
Computer Crimes, Digital Evidence Seizure and Analysis, Mobile Forensics
Cybercrimes and Cyberforensics
Classification, Lifting, Chance prints, Examination, Preservation, AFIS
Foot, Shoe, Tyre, Skid Marks, Gait Patterns
Iris scan, Systems and Applications
Speaker Identification, Voice Spectrometry, Acoustics, Forensic Relevance

units.unitTitle: Unit IX: Document and Handwriting Examination
topics: Types, Preliminary Examination, Photographic Reproduction, Erasures, Alterations, Secret Writings
Scientific Examination Techniques, Ink Analysis, Charred documents analysis
Identification Techniques, Forgeries, Credit Card Examination

units.unitTitle: Unit X: Forensic Medicine, Anthropology, Odontology and Entomology
topics: Types of Death, Post-Mortem examination, Digital autopsy/Virtopsy, various methods of estimating post mortem interval
Blunt injuries, Sharp injuries, Gunshot Wounds, Burns
Current laws pertaining to various sexual offences-rape, sodomy, POCSO, Collection of various evidences and their analysis and interpretation
Species, Age, Sex, Stature Estimation, Anthropometry, Skull Superimposition, Bite Marks, Role of artificial intelligence
Various types of insects used in forensic analysis, their life cycle and role in Estimation of postmortem interval, Entomotoxicology

importantNotes: Wherever Acts/Rule/Regulations are mentioned in syllabus, latest amendments/versions to be considered.
